## Berlin 4-Day Weather Snapshot

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg

Berlin starts cool and damp, then turns milder and brighter by midweek. Rain risk is highest on **Mar 10** and **Mar 13**, with the dry, sunniest day on **Mar 12**.

## Day-by-Day Forecast and What to Wear

| Date | Forecast | Rain Risk | Wind | What to Wear |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-10 | 8°C / 2°C, light rain | **High** | 18 km/h | Thermal base layer, sweater, waterproof jacket, closed shoes |
| 2026-03-11 | 10°C / 3°C, cloudy | **Low** | 12 km/h | Long-sleeve top, light knit, medium coat, comfortable shoes |
| 2026-03-12 | 14°C / 5°C, sunny | **Very low** | 10 km/h | Light layers, cardigan or thin jacket, sunglasses optional |
| 2026-03-13 | 12°C / 4°C, afternoon showers | **Medium-High** | 22 km/h | Layered outfit, wind-resistant jacket, waterproof outer layer |

## Wear-This Guide for Berlin

- **Mar 10:** Dress for wet and chilly weather. A warm layer under a rainproof jacket will feel best.
- **Mar 11:** Keep it simple with layers you can adjust. No heavy rain gear needed, but a coat still helps in the morning.
- **Mar 12:** This is the most comfortable day for lighter clothing. A thin jacket should be enough.
- **Mar 13:** Expect changeable conditions and stronger wind. Choose layers that dry quickly and block gusts.

## Rain Risk and Umbrella Advice

- **Bring an umbrella on Mar 10**: rain is likely, and it may stay damp through the day.
- **Carry an umbrella on Mar 13**: showers are expected later in the day, so a compact one is smart.
- **Skip the umbrella on Mar 11 and Mar 12** unless you want backup for changing conditions.
- A **water-resistant jacket** is more useful than a large umbrella if you’ll be walking a lot, especially on the windier day.
